cards.p: A customer texted asking about a detail. Reply with my packages [list], open times [times], and one question about their car.
I am a mobile detailer. Write a text asking [customer] about water, power and parking at [address] before tomorrow.
Write a short no show and late cancel policy for my detailing bookings: [hours] notice, [fee], said kindly.
Write a text for customers whose last detail was [X] weeks ago. Friendly, one open slot [day], easy yes.
Turn my prices [paste] into a simple menu by size: sedan, SUV, truck. Show what each package includes.
A customer sent photos of [problem]. Write a reply with a price range and why the final price needs a look.
Suggest 2 add ons for a [car] getting [package], only if they truly help. One plain line each, no pressure.
Write a short email to [local business] offering fleet washes for their [vans]: schedule, price per vehicle [price], next step.
Explain to [customer] in plain words what a [service] can and cannot fix on their [car], before I start.
Turn my care steps [paste] into a short aftercare text for [service]: what to do, what to avoid, how long.
A customer says I caused [issue]: [paste]. Reply calmly, ask for photos, and offer a time to look together.
Write a kind text telling [customer] heavy pet hair adds [price]. Explain why, and let them reply yes or skip.
Write the words for a small card I leave on the dash asking for a Google review, with a QR code spot.
Write a text asking [customer] for a Google review with a photo of their clean car. Short, link [link].
Write 5 different replies to 5 star reviews for my detailing business so they never sound copied. Under 25 words each.
Reply to this review saying my work left [issue]: [paste]. Calm, take it offline, offer to make it right.
Write a 15 second reel script for my [service] video: hook in 2 seconds, 3 shots, end with how to book.
Plan 7 posts for my detailing page this week from these photos: [describe]. One idea and caption each.
Write a post on getting a car ready for [season] in [city]: 3 simple tips, then my [package].
Write a short post explaining one car care myth customers ask me about: [myth]. Plain words, end with one tip.
Write a holiday gift card offer for my detailing: [amounts], how to buy [link], and when it expires [date].
[Customer] paid [amount] of [total] for their detail. Write a polite text with the balance and payment link [link].
Design a monthly wash membership from my prices [paste]: 2 tiers, what each includes, price, how to cancel.
Here are my monthly supply costs [paste] and jobs done [number]. What do products cost me per detail? Simple table.
